Bug_Title: Classes should not be compared by name
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the 'hasSellByDate' and 'isList' methods where classes are compared by their names instead of using 'instanceof' or 'Class.isAssignableFrom()'. This comparison can lead to incorrect results if classes with the same name exist in different packages.
Trigger_Explanation: The test cases trigger the bug by calling the'showBug' method which internally uses the 'hasSellByDate' and 'isList' methods. These methods compare classes by name, which is the bug we want to keep triggering.
